_about: The Kestrel module kit: standard rooms the architect places instead of typing walls. Read by scripts/kestrel/expand.mjs and check.mjs (A29, A30). Sizes are CLEAR (wall-face to wall-face) nominal sizes on the 0.5 m grid; expand turns each into a wall-centreline rect (size + wall thickness, rounded up to the grid). Local frame: south-west corner at 0,0, x east, z north; side S is the entry side. Fixed-content sizes are general knowledge unless a fact id is named. A "@path" value is read from facts.json. Format: docs/kestrel/schema.md section 7.
